plate_comment: Initializes the drivetrain ratio: clears the ETC1 out of gear flag, drivetrain_gear_range = 1 (top gear), drivetrain_ratio_raw / drivetrain_ratio / drivetrain_ratio_user_filtered (and its previous copy) = drivetrain_ratio_default, the filter state seeded with it and pointed at drivetrain_ratio_filter_coefficient, and drivetrain_ratio_engine_period_valid_flag = 1 (was initGovernorJ1939Bypass)

With a J1939 vehicle speed source (vehicle_speed_sensor_type_cal 4 / 5), the vehicle at or above vehicle_speed_minimum, the engine not stopped and valid ETC1 out of gear data, it copies the ETC1 out of gear flag into drivetrain_ratio_unsettled_flag and drivetrain_ratio_out_of_gear_cruise_disable_flag, and while out of gear holds drivetrain_ratio_user_filtered at drivetrain_ratio (was etcTransmissionModeControl)
output_shaft_speed_saved = output_shaft_speed_current (was cm848_output_shaft_speed_save) | earlier note: jlaustill reviewed 2026-6-4 - naming makes since, hopefully accurate
